visual_synopsis: Two young men - one in a black t-shirt with suspenders, one in an orange vest - stand against a blue wall in a sunny courtyard arguing at length, and a third in a bright pink shirt joins them. They then walk up to an apartment block where a wake is going on: a heavyset woman in black weeps by the door and older men sit head-down on stools along the shabby corridor while the young men come in to pay their respects.
